diagnosis: Rosai–Dorfman disease involving a lymph node
legend: At low magnification, the lymph node has a striated appearance due to distended pale sinuses and intervening darker cords of lymphocytes and plasma cells.

diagnosis: Rosai–Dorfman disease involving a lymph node
legend: A large histiocyte with numerous intracytoplasmic lymphocytes (emperipolesis) is present in a distended sinus.

diagnosis: Rosai–Dorfman disease involving a lymph node
legend: Numerous characteristic histiocytes are positive for S100. The reaction product also outlines unstained small lymphocytes within the histiocyte cytoplasm.

diagnosis: Rosai–Dorfman disease involving a lymph node
legend: The histiocytes are positive for phosphorylated ERK, indicating that the MAPK/ERK pathway is activated, probably due to a mutated gene in the pathway.

diagnosis: Rosai–Dorfman disease involving the parotid gland
legend: In this field, Rosai–Dorfman disease infiltrates and distorts the acinar tissue of the parotid gland. Although there are many characteristic histiocytes, emperipolesis is relatively minimal, which is common at extranodal sites of disease.
This extranodal Rosai–Dorfman disease demonstrates complete replacement of the sinonasal tract tissue by sheets of histiocytes, showing emperipolesis of lymphocytes.
